[EN] The argon invasion has taken so much away from us—we no longer have a place to call our homeland. We've settled here, but this is no more our home than Velika.

It's not just because we're constantly under attack, either. Our home had its share of attacks, but it was still ours.

This...this is just where we're staying. For now. I hope.
[ES] La invasión argon nos ha quitado tanto que ya no tenemos un lugar al que llamar patria. Nos hemos instalado aquí, pero esto no es más nuestro hogar que Velika.

Tampoco es solo porque estemos bajo ataque constante. Nuestro hogar tuvo su parte de ataques, pero aun así era nuestro.

Esto... esto es solo donde nos estamos quedando. Por ahora. Eso espero.
